notes.subject: עם אבותינו
notes.rationale: 'le boholo ba rena' — 're beile dibe le boholo' (ra etsa seo ba se entseng le rena) kgahlanong le 'le bommagabolonag bolugile'

notes.subject: ra leka ka tsela e sego e tokologilego
notes.rationale: העוינו 'ra kgokga/go loga' — modu wa go fapafapa, go ikokobetsa

translation: Re beile dibe le boholo ba rena, ra leka ka tsela e sego e tokologilego, ra etsa sebe.
